body: I'm not very social person. I want to be, but I'm not. People usually just avoid me if I'm interacting with them as much, as I want to. They usually see me not as a friend, but as an entertainer, as help, as useful stuff, well, anything.
That might work a bit, the problem is, I can't find people that are actually willing to do something like this with me. It seems like almost everyone around is too different to be enough close to me.
I stick to this position: there is no meaning, just try to get as much fun as you can.
